name: description
value: Specifications grading: you earn a letter by meeting every column. Enter counts after revisions and new attempts.

name: Plus and minus
value: Above your base grade in two columns adds a plus. Meeting all but one criterion for the next grade up gives that grade with a minus. The site's example of A/B/A/A fits both rules and earns an A−, so this page uses the higher grade when both apply.

name: Passing
value: Meeting every D criterion is required to pass. The page shows F if any column is below D, even when the minus rule might otherwise apply.

name: Labs
value: 3 M meets both C and D, so a lab column at 3 counts as a C here.

name: Engagement
value: The site says there will be at least 100 credits, graded out of 100. This page stops at 100.

name: Project
value: The highest project grades also need attendance on project work days and during the final exam period.
